entries.reason: Script-visible shader compute dispatch owns GPU binding admission and fallback boundaries.
evidence: docs/dev/重构代码质量与系统完整性规范.md
entries.entity_scope: Compute shader and GPU buffer handles admitted by the gpgpu backend.
entries.view: Generation/backend-checked shader and buffer handles plus fixed binding slots.
entries.read_set: Shader bytecode, buffer bindings, dispatch dimensions and backend readiness.
entries.write_set: GPU dispatch submission state and explicit failure/fallback result to the caller.
entries.structural_changes: No ECS structural mutation; GPU resources are created/destroyed through backend ownership APIs.
entries.events: No gameplay events; dispatch completion/failure is observed through the compute API result.
entries.services: Borrowed Vulkan/gpgpu backend, shader registry and buffer registry; no callbacks retained.
